projects.title: OmniSource Chatbot
projects.impact: Autonomous routing across vector search and SQL with full citation tracking
projects.description: A multi-source analytics chatbot that autonomously routes user questions to the correct backend: semantic vector search over PDFs, or SQL queries over structured data.

projects.title: QLoRA Fine-Tuning (Llama 3.2 3B)
projects.impact: Accuracy improved from 89.7% to 97.4% with only 0.75% of parameters trained
projects.description: Fine-tuned Meta's Llama 3.2 3B model using QLoRA to specialize it for classifying financial news sentiment.

projects.title: Text-to-SQL Conversational Engine
projects.tagline: Natural Language to SQL with Gemini
projects.impact: 90%+ query accuracy across 10+ schemas with sub-2s response times
projects.description: Built an NL-to-SQL system powered by Google Gemini with a decoupled FastAPI backend and Streamlit frontend.

projects.title: Gender Classification with ViT
projects.impact: 97% validation accuracy using state-of-the-art transformer architecture
projects.description: Deep learning project implementing a Vision Transformer model for binary gender classification from facial images.
